ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Of DbgModel.DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "DbgModel.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\dbgmodel\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\"))) AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\WindowsApps\\\\Microsoft\\\.WinDbg\\_") OR (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Windows\\ Kits\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Windows\\ Kits\\\\")))
